name: sharper-skills
description: Seven skills: three prompt lenses (higher, deeper, wider), an evidence loop for building and debugging (signal-first-plan, debugging-by-constraints, debug-retro), and a report with questions, graded by the agent, that checks you understand what a session decided or changed (defend).
